# Site agent events

<!-- Generated by `uv run python -m waldur_mastermind.marketplace_site_agent.contracts --update` from `src/waldur_mastermind/marketplace_site_agent/contracts.py`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Mastermind tells site agents about changes they must act on by publishing STOMP messages. This page lists every message, its fields and the code that sends it. The same contracts are published as an AsyncAPI 3.0.0 document, `contracts/asyncapi.yaml` in the waldur-mastermind repository, which standard AsyncAPI tooling can validate and generate code from.

- Contracts version: `1.0.0`. Its major part changes on every breaking change.
- Minimum site agent version: `1.0.2`.

## Transport

Messages are JSON objects sent over RabbitMQ Web-STOMP. Each registered event consumer has one queue, `consumer_<consumer UUID>`, in the vhost named by its owner's user UUID. The agent subscribes to `/amq/queue/<queue>` with `client-individual` acknowledgment, so a message it does not acknowledge is delivered again. Delivery is at-least-once and unordered across events: use `emitted_at` to discard an update older than one already applied.

A consumer receives the messages that its scope bindings and object types admit. Several messages share an object type, so tell them apart by `action` or by the fields present.

Site agents before 1.0.7 subscribe through the deprecated per-subscription topics instead. Those carry each message's own fields plus `offering_uuid` only: no `object_type`, `schema_version` or `emitted_at`, and none of the context fields marked optional below that the payload enrichers add.

## Envelope

The dispatcher adds these fields to every message.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `object_type` | string | yes | ObservableObjectType of the event |
| `schema_version` | integer | yes | Version of the envelope format |
| `emitted_at` | string | yes | ISO 8601 time the event was emitted, for discarding stale updates |
| `event_type` | string | no | Event type, when the event comes from the event log |
| `offering_uuid` | string | no | UUID of the offering; added to every offering-scoped event |

## Messages

### Object type `order`

#### OrderMessage

Sent on every state transition of an order.

Sent by:

- `marketplace/handlers.py:send_order_state_change_to_message_queue`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_uuid` | string | yes | UUID of the order |
| `order_state` | string | yes | Display name of the order state |
| `order_type` | string | no | Order type |
| `resource_uuid` | string | no | UUID of the resource |
| `resource_backend_id` | string | no | Backend identifier of the resource |
| `resource_name` | string | no | Name of the resource |
| `project_uuid` | string | no | UUID of the project |
| `project_name` | string | no | Name of the project |
| `attributes` | object | no | Order attributes with secrets removed |
| `limits` | object | no | Resource limits |
| `plan_uuid` | string | no | UUID of the resource's plan, when it has one |

### Object type `resource_api_key_rotation`

#### ApiKeyCommandMessage

A command on one of a resource's API keys: create, rotate, pause, resume, update or delete. Carried on the resource_api_key_rotation observable type, which is named for the first command and kept so subscriptions do not change.

Sent by:

- `marketplace/utils.py:publish_api_key_event`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string: `create`, `rotate`, `pause`, `resume`, `delete`, `update` | yes | One of ResourceApiKeyActions |
| `resource_uuid` | string | yes | UUID of the resource |
| `resource_backend_id` | string | yes | Backend identifier of the resource |
| `api_key_uuid` | string | yes | UUID of the API key |
| `client_id` | string | yes | Backend client id of the key; blank on a key being created |
| `limits` | object or null | no | Monthly limits per component, null when the key has none; only on commands that carry the key's settings |
| `spending_limits` | object or null | no | Spending limits for every period, null when the key has none; only on commands that carry the key's settings |
| `allowed_models` | array of string | no | Models the key may call (['*'] for all, [] for none): the key's own list narrowed by its resource's model selection. Only on commands that carry the key's settings; absent from Waldur versions older than ['*'], where absence allows every model |

### Object type `service_provider_project_group`

#### ProjectGroupMessage

A provider project group was created, updated or deleted, or project groups were switched on or off for the provider.

Sent by:

- `marketplace/handlers.py:send_project_group_saved_message`
- `marketplace/handlers.py:send_project_group_deleted_message`
- `marketplace/handlers.py:send_project_groups_switch_message`
- `marketplace/project_groups.py:allocate_gid`

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | string: `create`, `update`, `delete`, `switch` | yes | Action: 'create' (the group got its first GID), 'update' (its name or GID changed), 'delete', or 'switch' (project groups switched on or off for the provider) |
| `service_provider_uuid` | string | yes | UUID of the service provider |
| `customer_uuid` | string | yes | UUID of the provider's organization |
| `project_group_uuid` | string | no | UUID of the group; absent on 'switch' |
| `project_uuid` | string or null | no | UUID of the group's project if it still exists; absent on 'switch' |
| `name` | string | no | Group name; absent on 'switch' |
| `gid` | integer or null | no | Group GID; absent on 'switch' |
| `changed_fields` | array of string | no | Fields that changed; only on 'update' |
| `project_groups_enabled` | boolean | no | The new setting; only on 'switch' |

## Event types not delivered to site agents

The same event stream carries these types for other consumers.

| Object type | Consumer |
| --- | --- |
| `resource_end_date_change_request` | Read by an external approval system, which answers through the request's approve/reject actions. |
| `user_profile` | User-centric event for global IdM/IGA consumers. |
| `user_ssh_key` | User-centric event for global IdM/IGA consumers. |
| `user_lifecycle` | User-centric event for global IdM/IGA consumers. |
| `service_provider_account` | Provider-scoped account event for consumers other than the agent; the agent follows offering_user, which is still emitted alongside it. |
| `call` | Proposal-domain event for consumers bound to a call. |
| `proposal` | Proposal-domain event for consumers bound to a call or proposal. |
